input.answer:
The CPI "Food" index (stores and restaurants combined, Canada, not seasonally adjusted) rose 2.2% from September 2025 to September 2026.

Arithmetic: (201.8 − 197.5) / 197.5 = 4.3 / 197.5 = 0.02177, or 2.2% to one decimal place.

Values are index levels (2002=100 basis as published by StatCan), and the table covers Food (member "Food", which includes "Food purchased from stores" and "Food purchased from restaurants"). Both endpoints were returned, with no suppressed values.
